Woodruff Keys

Woodruff Keys (Half-Moon Keys)

A key fitted into a half-moon-shaped slot machined into the shaft.
Because the key itself can tilt freely within the shaft's tapered groove, it absorbs machining errors in the keyways of the shaft and hub.
Mainly used for securing small shafts and tapered shafts.
